Disclaimer

DOB records shown on this webpage are sourced from NYC Open Data. User-entered notes, planning details, imported files, and address-search results are not DOB records. Vertical Terminal is a convenience tool only and is not an official DOB source.

You are responsible for reviewing all information presented here and verifying it against the official DOB records before relying on it for any filing, decision, or action.

The creator of this webpage assumes no responsibility or liability for errors, omissions, outdated information, or any other inaccuracies that may appear. By clicking Agree, you acknowledge that you understand and accept these terms.

Uploaded PDFs and spreadsheets are processed in your browser. Saved notes, CAT 5 bypasses, and display preferences remain in this browser's local storage until you clear them; other map data is kept in browser memory and in files you explicitly open, save, or export. Address searches are sent to OpenStreetMap Nominatim, and DOB lookups are sent to NYC Open Data.

💡 Tips ›
  • Click a marker to see building details
  • Use ✓ in popup to mark a building complete
  • Use 🔄 in popup to mark a building in process
  • Use ⭐ in popup to favorite a building
  • Use 👁️ in popup to hide a building
  • Use 📅 dropdown to assign a month
  • Use 🗓️ in popup to schedule test dates
  • Scheduled markers: octagon = CAT, square = PVI, diamond = both
  • Past-due test dates appear in Settings to confirm
  • Completion markers: green = Full, blue = PVI only, purple = Category only
  • In-process buildings turn orange
  • Favorited buildings turn purple
  • Add custom locations with the ➕ button
  • Save your work — data is not kept between sessions

This website uses the NYC Department of Buildings Safety Violations API to provide up-to-date information about elevator violations.

The API provides information about violations issued for elevator devices, including violation numbers, issue dates, statuses, types, and remarks.
